label: HR management
h1Parts: — because it lives where work happens.
lead: Standalone HR tools force the administrator to enter the same data twice — once when the staff member joins, once at month-end for payroll. Lucoze’s HR sits in the same database as appointments and billing. Attendance, leave, payroll, statutory — all derived from work that’s already logged.

rows.title: Punch in three ways. We meet the staff where they are.
rows.lead: Biometric at the door, NFC tag for the front desk, WhatsApp for the doctor doing rounds. All three flow into the same attendance ledger. End-of-month reconciliation takes minutes, not hours.
bullets: Shift planning with conflict detection — no doctor accidentally double-booked.
Half-day, overtime, public holiday rules built-in for Indian labour law.

rows.title: ESI, PF, TDS — calculated. Not estimated.
rows.lead: Each pay cycle the system computes deductions, generates payslips, exports the bank file, and prepares the statutory challan. You approve; we do the math.
bullets: Salary structure templates per role — OPD doctor, surgeon, technician, admin.
Statutory remits (PF, ESI, TDS) reconciled and challan-ready.
Payslips PDF + WhatsApp to staff — they have a record, you have an audit trail.

faqs.q: What size practice is HR worth turning on for?
faqs.a: From ~10 staff. Below that, a spreadsheet often beats software. We’re honest about this — the HR module turns on by request, not by default.

faqs.q: Is it compliant with the new Labour Codes (2026)?
faqs.a: The four Labour Codes change a lot of forms. We track the rollout state-by-state — statutory exports update automatically when a state notifies effective dates.
